column2: The game shows your ranged weapon's speed here as a cooldown.

The gold gift box in the top corner opens beta week in numbers: how many builds got made, which class built the most, the spec each class chose, the talent everyone takes and the one nobody does, and the most shared build per class drawn point by point. Six days, 16,176 builds, none of it about who you are. Recounted since with the days that were missed: five days, 13 to 17 Sep, at least 79,715 builds. See the newer entry.
The tank seal: every hit adds Holy damage, and with a shield up an absorb worth half of it. Level 10, ranks to 58.
Trainable now, not a talent, and quicker: 2 sec cast (Classic 3), 6 sec cooldown shared with Multi-Shot. Level 20, ranks to 60. A reader caught the cast time on Xaryu's stream.
Twelfth beta build
Unchanged from Classic: level 30 in the Fury tab, ranks at 42 and 52. Improved Intercept stays in the Fury tree.

Web on Discord noticed the spellbook said Instant while the Enhancement tree still had two points to put into Improved Ghost Wolf. The Instant came from Guzu's Shaman, which had that talent at 2/2. It cuts 1 sec per rank, so the untalented spell is a 2 sec cast, down from 3 in Classic, and the book now says so. No untalented Shaman has hovered it on footage yet, so the note on the tooltip says where the number comes from. Corrected the next day: untalented Ghost Wolf is the Classic 3 sec cast (see 16 Sep).

Went back through every spellbook page Soda, Savix and Xaryu opened on stream and read the tooltips off the footage. 174 spells now show the real Forever text in green instead of the Classic fallback, across all nine classes: every Paladin seal and blessing, the Shaman totems and shocks, Druid forms and cat and bear abilities, the Rogue openers and finishers, Hunter traps and aspects, Mage armors and wards, Warlock curses and stones, Priest heals and shadow spells. Notable reads: Slam has a 15 sec cooldown (18 since build 70009), Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot, Frost Trap slows 60%, Eviscerate scales with Attack Power, Blessing of Protection and Divine Shield apply Forbearance, Blind is 30 energy on 5 min, and Skysight and Read Ley Line last 15 min when you find a convergence or ley line. Damage numbers include whatever gear and talents that streamer had, and the source line under each tooltip says whose character it was. Racial cards got the same treatment.
With a wand equipped, the game shows the wand's speed as a cooldown and no Requires Wands line.
Works differently since this build, per Blizzard's 24 Sep notes: only spells and attacks that deal damage set it off, and it no longer breaks crowd control. Its tooltip in game reads the same.
Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec on up to 4 targets (Classic 10%). Xaryu's stream via a reader; the Classic number from the files.
Works in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Form now, where it costs nothing and has a 6 sec cooldown. Classic needed the Faerie Fire (Feral) talent for that, and that talent is gone.
Works in combat now. Classic's traps could only be placed out of combat (Blizzard's Class Highlights Part 2, 1:37).

You know Classic. The Priest guide at talentsforever.com/priest/changes is only what is different now, told the way the video tells it: your buffs and your heals and the rest of what is new, the trees before and after, Discipline, Holy and Shadow, your heals and your damage rank by rank, the six races that can be a Priest, and what people are building. Each chapter has its part of the video right there, and every number comes from the same beta data the calculator runs on. Priest won the last vote on Back to Class.

You know Classic. The Shaman guide at talentsforever.com/shaman/changes is only what is different now, told the way the video tells it: the totem bar and the rest of what is new, the trees before and after, Elemental, Enhancement and Restoration, your damage and your gear, the races that can be a Shaman, and what people are building. Each chapter has its part of the video right there, and every number comes from the same beta data the calculator runs on. Shaman won the last vote, so the next one is open on Back to Class until 5 pm Eastern on Oct 3.

Your gear works in form now: your weapon adds to your melee damage in Bear Form, weapon enchants like Crusader and procs like Windfury Totem work in Bear and Cat Form, and you can drink potions and use items without shifting out (Blizzard's Class Highlights Part 3, 0:29 to 1:48).
